title: Driver task record
description: One task, written by the driver (K9, §2.5 step 2, D43/F09) before the worker starts. Host-written only: it has no model output. The driver joins `tracker ready` with the placeholder census, the current goal and the attempt history; deferred proof debt is never selectable before its goal, so `deferred_debt` must be false.

id.description: The task id, unique across the run history.

kind.description: `state-declaration`: write a planned declaration's statement (an open node); `replace-placeholder`: replace a placeholder (`opaque` or `@[placeholder]`, which tracker counts as proved) by a real definition; `prove-theorem`: prove a stated theorem.

decl.description: The declaration to state, replace or prove.

module.description: The module that holds or will hold it.

plan_node.description: The plan node id (normally equal to `decl`), or null for an unplanned placeholder.

plan_file.description: The plan file that holds the node, or null.

goal.description: The project goal the task serves (the project's own vocabulary, for example a goal number).

attempt.description: This attempt's number (1 for the first).

attempt_limit.description: The attempt limit K: the driver selects a target only while `attempt` <= `attempt_limit`.

base_commit.description: The commit the staged workspace starts from.

inputs.description: The inputs the selection read, with their hashes (freshness, D39).

path.description: Where it was read from, or null for command output.

sha256.description: sha256 of the filled prompt sent to the worker.

result_schema_sha256.description: sha256 of the worker-result output schema passed to the worker.

effort.description: The reasoning effort, in the CLI's vocabulary.

deferred_debt.description: Guard: the target is not deferred proof debt (an admitted main theorem, copied proofs) before its goal. A record with true is invalid: such a task is never selectable.

commit.description: A full git commit id (40 lowercase hex digits).

decl.description: An absolute Lean declaration id as `Name.toString` prints it (the ids `tracker graph` uses).

module.description: A Lean module name, for example `Pkg.Sub.Module`.

path.description: A file path relative to the repository root, with `/` separators.

provider.description: The model CLI: `claude` (Claude Code, `claude -p`) or `codex` (`codex exec`).

sha256.description: A SHA-256 hash: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.
